P1.1.text: Enabling better, smarter, safer healthcare | Solventum

P1.2.text: Solventum is a healthcare company built from a legacy of innovation and dedicated to enabling better, smarter, safer healthcare to improve lives. Learn more.

P1.3.text: Welcome to the Acera team and their innovative Restrata® technology. Together, we are advancing the future of wound care and expanding access for surgeons and their patients.

P1.4.text: Solutions Our company Company news & stories Explore more

P1.5.text: We create innovative products and services that touch millions of lives, transform the patient experience and save time for healthcare professionals

P1.6.text: We listen with empathy and precision to understand your needs. Then we go to work, pushing the boundaries of health, material and data sciences to solve for you.

P1.7.text: We work closely with healthcare professionals to design new ways to achieve positive health outcomes and more efficient care.

P1.8.text: We offer advanced, clinically-proven solutions that help you grow your business and deliver beautiful, healthy smiles.

P1.9.text: We are your strategic partner, helping you make real-time, informed decisions that drive efficiency and meet every goal.

P1.11.text: Our products are designed to help your innovations go from lab to full-scale production faster and more efficiently.

P1.12.text: Our solutions help you address everyday health needs with leading brands you can trust.

P1.13.text: When Dr. Matthew MacEwan noticed a gap in wound care options, he set out to create something different: a fully synthetic scaffold designed to work with the body's natural healing process.

P1.15.text: A dental visit can feel overwhelming for some patients. See how one dentist and a nonprofit in Brazil are bringing preventive oral care to people with sensory-inclusive care.

P1.16.text: Read how Solventum employee Linda Doerr found warmth and comfort in the 3M Bair Hugger warming gown during her personal battle with colorectal cancer.

P1.18.text: Get inspired by the stories and people behind our innovations.

P1.19.text: Expand your knowledge of the latest techniques and training with the wide range of courses available on Solventum Education.

P2.1.text: About our company and purpose | Solventum

P2.2.text: Find information, answers and links on our history as a healthcare company, current leadership, purpose, values, impact, our global footprint and more.

P2.3.text: A new healthcare company with a rich history

P2.4.text: With more than 70 years of delivering healthcare innovations, we continue to move the industry forward by helping to solve our customers’ biggest challenges.

P2.5.text: The world needs you at your best, so we help solve to save you time and help your patients get and stay healthy.

P2.6.text: Our products are designed to help your innovations go from idea to full-scale production efficiently.

P2.7.text: From your first patient interaction to post-care analysis, we provide you with clinically based measures and data management for optimal efficiency.

P2.8.text: "As the need for solutions that enhance health care delivery and improve patient outcomes increases, we have the right technologies, global capabilities and leading expertise to meet those needs while also shaping the future of health for individuals around the world. We are committed to enabling better, smarter, and safer healthcare to improve lives."

P2.10.text: We believe empathy is the cornerstone of improving care

P2.11.text: So we listen closely to our customers and the people whose lives they impact for the insights that help us improve well-being around the world.

P2.12.text: This creates positive change for our stakeholders, and most importantly, the people and patients our innovations help every day.

P2.13.text: We set high standards for ourselves and work hard to exceed them. By bringing quality, reliability and integrity to the way we work, we ensure patient safety and compliance while achieving exceptional results for the people we serve.

P2.2.text: CSR encompasses our aspirations as a company as well as the practical ways we address evolving Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) standards to identify and quantify our sustainability and societal impact. Our commitment to CSR builds trust with our key stakeholders, including employees, patients, customers, and investors. It improves our ability to manage risk, reduces costs, and benefits the communities where we operate as we continue to advance our purpose “to improve the health and quality of people’s lives.”

P2.3.text: Our CSR Pillars serve as a framework as we move toward setting meaningful and measurable goals and enhancing transparency and disclosure relating to our CSR program. We are committed to ensuring responsibility remains a driving factor in our corporate governance. We continue to observe strong business ethics grounded in morality and compliance, while mitigating risks and seeking out and implementing environmentally sound operational practices. We focus on people through professional development and employee programs centered on health, well-being, inclusion and safety, and enhance our humanitarian aid and medical grants process to ensure a more effective approach.

P2.4.text: Teleflex’s Climate Targets Validated by the Science Based Targets Initiative (SBTi)

P2.5.text: Teleflex has responded to the SBTi’s urgent call for corporate climate action by committing to align with 1.5°C and net-zero through the Business Ambition for 1.5°C campaign. Teleflex is proud to announce the SBTi has validated Teleflex’s near-term science-based emissions reduction target, whereby Teleflex committed to reduce absolute scope 1 and 2 GHG emissions 54.6% from a 2019 base year. Teleflex also committed to reduce absolute scope 3 GHG emissions from purchased goods and services, upstream transportation and distribution, waste generated in operations and business travel by 32.5% within the same timeframe. The SBTi has also validated Teleflex’s long-term science-based emissions reduction target, whereby Teleflex committed to reduce absolute Scopes 1, 2, and 3 GHG emissions 90% from a 2019 base year.
